findings.current: - All Status conditions have been restored!
findings.defect: The English says the abnormal conditions themselves were restored, reversing the intended consequence that Taekyung recovered from them.
findings.rationale: The notice confirms successful detoxification and recovery from every abnormal status, not the restoration of those statuses.
findings.replacement: - All Status conditions have been cleared!

findings.current: My opponent wasn’t some ordinary martial artist.
findings.defect: Calling Mungyeong Taekyung’s “opponent” incorrectly frames their relationship as adversarial when 상대 here simply refers to the person he is dealing with.
findings.rationale: Mungyeong is evaluating and teaching Taekyung, not opposing him in a contest or battle.
findings.replacement: The man I was dealing with wasn’t some ordinary martial artist.
findings.source: 상대는 그저 그런 무림인이 아니라, 천하에서도 손꼽히는 초절정 고수인 살성이다.

findings.current: But this was basically the crime of being irritating.
findings.defect: “The crime of being irritating” is unnatural and misses 괘씸죄’s sense of being punished arbitrarily for displeasing or offending someone.
findings.rationale: The following sentence explains that Taekyung must suffer until Mungyeong personally approves of him, making the subjective-displeasure sense essential.
findings.replacement: But this was basically the crime of getting on someone’s bad side.
findings.source: 하지만 이건, 죄목으로 따지자면 괘씸죄와 비슷하다.

findings.current: At this point, he had clearly decided to hide himself properly.
findings.defect: “Hide himself properly” is an unnatural literal rendering and does not convey Jeok Cheongang’s firm determination to remain hidden.
findings.rationale: 단단히 작정하다 emphasizes a firm, deliberate decision rather than the manner or competence with which he hid.
findings.replacement: At this point, he had clearly made up his mind to stay hidden.
findings.source: 이 정도면 단단히 작정하고 숨은 것이 틀림없다.

findings.defect: The single heavy impact sound does not preserve the source’s repeated soft puffing or puncturing sound that signals the second concealed poison trap.
findings.rationale: 푸푹 is repeated and soft rather than a single dull impact; preserving that ambiguity suits either a powder discharge or a concealed puncturing mechanism without adding an explanation.

summary: One reversed System consequence and several localized meaning or prose issues.
